ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan Core
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build of Ancient & Medieval Japan Core.
Extends Medieval Overhaul with agriculture, primary processing, materials, and village-life systems inspired by pre-Edo Japan. Medieval Overhaul is required.
The current development slice includes field-crop agriculture and the New Village scenario: five ordinary villagers begin with basic everyday technologies and limited supplies. AMJ Backgrounds is not required. Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul is optional; when present, AMJ crops use its explicit cold-death framework.
Save compatibility: Adding to or removing from existing saves has not been verified. This development build adds custom crops, items, processing content, and a start-specific player faction and pawn kind. Scenario conditions only apply to new starts. Safe removal is not guaranteed, including saves created with New Village.
